1.0.7: Court fees (new in 1.0.7): organizers can add their Venmo, Cash App, PayPal or Zelle username under Me → Payment methods. Players who haven't paid see a button that opens that payment app or website. The money never goes through Badie, Badie takes no cut, and it is for court fees at a physical venue, so it doesn't use in-app purchase (guideline 3.1.3(e)).

To try a match: tap + → Match · round robin, add players with Type a name, then Start. Guest sign-up and Run courts are on groups you organize (Edit group → Guest sign-up; Run courts shows on a session from 1 hour before it starts).
